name: J. C. Williamson
role: Medora carpenter; Billings County clerk and register of deeds, 1886
bio: J. C. Williamson was a Medora carpenter who returned in March 1884 from work on the company's ice house at Miles City, took the carpentry contract for George Fitzgerald's new hotel in November 1884 with Peter Book doing the brick work, and built a carpenter shop near the hotel in January 1885. He shot with the Bad Lands Gun Club in 1885. In April 1886 he was elected Billings County's register of deeds and county clerk, served as clerk to the county commissioners from their first meeting in May, and was secretary of a September Republican caucus. In October 1886 the citizens' convention renominated him for county clerk and register of deeds, and he was re-elected in November.
